sn47.29:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn47.29:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sirivaḍḍho gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn47.29:1.3: atha kho sirivaḍḍho gahapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi
sn47.29:1.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vanda
sn47.29:1.5: sirivaḍḍho bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
sn47.29:1.6: so āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandatīti
sn47.29:1.8: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā ānando yena sirivaḍḍhassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn47.29:1.9: evaṃ bhanteti kho so puriso sirivaḍḍhassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
sn47.29:1.10: sirivaḍḍho bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno so āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandati
sn47.29:1.12: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā ānando yena sirivaḍḍhassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn47.29:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena sirivaḍḍhassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho āyasmā ānando sirivaḍḍhaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
sn47.29:2.2: kacci te gahapati khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti. paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn47.29:2.3: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn47.29:3.1: tasmā tiha te gahapati evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
sn47.29:3.2: kāye kāyānupassī viharissāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.29:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharissāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassanti.
sn47.29:4.1: yeme bhante bhagavatā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā saṃvijjanti te dhammā mayi ahaṃ ca tesu dhammesu sandissāmi.
sn47.29:4.2: ahañhi bhante kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.29:4.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.29:4.6: yāni cimāni bhante bhagavatā pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni desitāni nāhaṃ bhante yaṅkiñci attani appahīnaṃ samanupassāmīti.
sn47.29:4.7: lābhā te gahapati suladdhaṃ te gahapati
